target.html:
Watch

Commander: Mood below your usual for several days

Why

Mood 2/5 today and at least 1.5 points below your baseline of 4/5 for 6 days. Isolation and confinement are a known spaceflight hazard.

Crew action

Book a private family conference or behavioral health call; protect sleep and exercise; tell the crew medical officer if you want tasks rebalanced.
